title: Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans — Store Scope, Grace and Visit Corrections Card
content:
# Store Scope, Grace and Visit Corrections Card

For each Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans tier, this card gives the stores where visits are honored, the grace allowed after the term ends, whether a plan visit stands aside while factory complimentary maintenance pays, the window for reinstating a redemption recorded in error, and how many times a fleet plan may be moved to a replacement vehicle.

| Plan | Visits honored at | Grace after expiration date (calendar days) | Grace beyond expiration odometer (miles) | Plan visit not used for a service in-force factory complimentary maintenance pays | Reinstatement window after a redemption (calendar days) | Fleet substitutions allowed per plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | Selling store only | 0 | 0 | Yes | 30 | 0 (not allowed) |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | Selling store only | 0 | 0 | Yes | 30 | 0 (not allowed) |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | All group stores | 30 | 1000 | Yes | 30 | 0 (not allowed) |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | All group stores | 30 | 1000 | Yes | 30 | 0 (not allowed) |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | All group stores | 60 | 2000 | Yes | 30 | 0 (not allowed) |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | All group stores | 0 | 0 | Yes | 30 | 1 |

## Reading the card

- **Grace** applies to a visit booked before expiration. A grace of 0 days and 0 miles means no visit is honored after the term ends.
- **Reinstatement window** counts calendar days after the entry date of the redemption being reinstated.
- **Fleet substitutions** of 0 mean the plan may not be moved to another vehicle. The Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit may be moved once.
- The Essentials tiers are honored only at the store that sold the plan. Every other tier is honored at every Kessler store.
